QVPIC is the Quaternion Vortex Persistent Identity Conduit.
Topological memory uses winding number and braiding phase.
RingConeChain stores facts in a 216-cube hierarchical double-cone.
ShellCube radial differential enforces global consistency.

The default production path is RubikConeConduit with quaternion-compressed shards.
Recall uses dual-cone geometry plus safe_cosine alignment.
Drift protection benchmarks report roughly 5.68x recovery vs noisy vectors.

VQCEnhancedHelicalConduit is the experimental OAM-modulated variant.
Copresheaf TNN layers diffuse reasoning on the RingConeChain complex.
Identity remains frozen while higher-order topological reasoning runs.
